name: trackiq-amazon-campaign-structure-audit
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Sponsored Ads Structure Audit
summary: Audits how an Amazon Sponsored Ads account is built rather than how it performed last week — ad groups crowded with unrelated products, the same product advertised in a dozen ad groups competing with itself, keywords stacked in every match type inside one ad group, spend sitting outside any portfolio, and selling products with no ad at all — ranked by the spend each problem touches, with a fix order the team can work through.
